turns.content: Define sigma^(mu nu)=i/2[gamma^mu,gamma^nu], show that it is antisymmetric, and count its independent components in four dimensions.
Use its role in infinitesimal Dirac-spinor transformations and the angular-momentum decomposition to distinguish intrinsic spin from orbital angular momentum and four-momentum.
Compare the six sigma^(mu nu) matrices with the ten generators of the Poincare algebra. Identify the subgroup they represent and the missing generators.
Check the conclusion against the distinction between Lorentz transformations and spacetime translations.
State the physical role of the gamma-matrix commutator and whether it generates Lorentz transformations alone or the full Poincare group.
